about_the_game:
Have you ever wanted to shout at the hero of a horror movie "don't go down into that basement"?! Friendly advice to the creepypasta hero not to check what's knocking at the door and just call the police? Explain to buyers of a haunted house that you shouldn't wait until the last minute to call an exorcist? Creepy Support gives you such a chance ;-)

In it, you get a job in online support for people who have encountered anomalous-creepy paranormality. And whether they will be able to escape depends only on your advice. Choose your questions carefully, carefully study the photos and audio recordings sent by clients - and perhaps they will be able to survive until dawn... By the way, don't you think it's strange that such a job even exists? Something is fishy with your employer... ;-)

In the final version you will find

  • 30 stories with multiple endings in each

  • several endings in the global plot

  • quotes from classic horror films and creepypastas, along with the breaking of their tropes and templates

  • retro interface

  • kilotons of text, written by a professional programmer

  • absolutely total absence of the SCP Foundation in the author's sources of inspiration (for everyone who thinks otherwise, the MTF "Copylefters" has already left)

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains text descriptions of dangerous situations that the characters find themselves in for mystical or paranormal reasons, and which may be dangerous for them. The game also contains moderately frightening illustrations and sounds that describe such situations. The game does NOT contain images of corpses, body parts or other things that may seem disgusting.

short_description: Save people from terrible paranormal dangers as a support operator of a secret SCP-like organization! Ask questions, give advice and watch the consequences of your choices... multiple endings in each story ;-)
